limitations: Host CPU execution rate changed during earlier diagnostics with the same compiler and graph. Earlier unstable cohorts and profiles are excluded; only this steady paired cohort supports the reported ratios.
Boolean solver is shared across distributed targets; these timings and executable comparisons are macOS ARM64 only.
No runtime speedup is claimed: every before/after executable pair is byte-identical.
This increment does not establish the larger cold-compilation or frontend goals, LLVM compatibility, or package reuse.
